stage: Stage 17B — frozen direct-customer conventional learner benchmark
research_question: On the frozen 48-feature direct-customer representation, which conventional supervised learner provides the strongest theft discrimination under the new DEV_TRAIN to DEV_VAL protocol?

representation.revision_policy: No feature addition, removal, redefinition, or DEV_VAL-driven selection is permitted.

lightgbm.installation: pip install --no-deps lightgbm; 1.4 MB compiled wheel; no core dependency replacement

xgboost.reason: Not installed; skipped before scoring because adding its substantially larger compiled runtime was not considered a lightweight environment change.

catboost.reason: Not installed; skipped before scoring because adding its substantially larger compiled runtime was not considered a lightweight environment change.

logistic_regression.scaling: StandardScaler fitted only on DEV_TRAIN customers

class_imbalance_policy: All primary candidates are unweighted. No weighted variants, SMOTE, Tomek links, GAN augmentation, or synthetic balancing.
fit_policy: Fit every candidate once on DEV_TRAIN only. No DEV_VAL data is supplied to fit or preprocessing.
evaluation_policy: Score DEV_VAL once after all configurations are frozen. Primary metrics are customer average precision then ROC-AUC. Precision, recall, F1, and confusion counts are secondary.
threshold_policy: Maximize positive-class F1 on DEV_VAL with the established deterministic highest-threshold tie break; acknowledge resulting threshold metrics as optimistic.
selection_policy: Highest DEV_VAL average precision, then ROC-AUC. Model size and runtime break only essentially equivalent discrimination. Accuracy is not used.

bootstrap_policy.comparison: winner minus Stage 17B HGB; if HGB wins, HGB minus the second-best AP candidate

importance_policy: For the winning tree model, independently permute each frozen customer feature across DEV_VAL for five repeats with seed 42 and report mean decreases in ROC-AUC and average precision. No feature removal follows.

decision_policy.A: A non-HGB conventional learner has higher AP and ROC-AUC than HGB, both paired 95% intervals are above zero, and its observed AP or ROC-AUC gain is at least 0.01.
decision_policy.B: Decision A is not met and the best candidate has ROC-AUC at least 0.70 and average precision at least 0.25; retain HGB for simplicity if models are essentially equivalent or HGB remains strongest.
decision_policy.C: The best candidate has ROC-AUC below 0.70 or average precision below 0.25, so DEV_VAL does not support the historical Stage 16 formulation result.

data_access_policy: Only original-train customer data assigned DEV_TRAIN or DEV_VAL may be loaded into matrices. CONFIRMATION and FINAL_TEST features, labels, predictions, and performance are closed.
